content:
maria: Ran a quick int8 microbench across AWS/GCP/Azure for the same A100 SKU — hit an odd p95 divergence on GCP us-central, leaving throughput basically unchanged.
sam: what model/config did you run? seq len / batch / quant pipeline?
maria: Llama-2-13b int8, seq=2048, batches=1 and 8 surface tests, quant pipeline=GPTQ-derived, runtime=redwood-serving-prod with our custom kernel selector. cuBLAS versions differed: aws gdk node ~12.1.0, gcp node ~12.2.3, azure ~12.1.0. quick summary table:
```
provider   p95(ms)   p50(ms)   qps(batch8)
aws        42        12        185
gcp        78        13        180
azure      45        12        182
```
maria: note throughput (qps) roughly equal, but tail on GCP is ~1.8x. nvprof/nsys logs point to algo fallback during the large GEMM for kv cache updates.
jun: whoa — any thermal throttling / clock governor differences? could be sustained clock drop or sm throttles.
maria: checked clocks: GCP shows steady clocks but we observed cuBLAS selecting a different algo path there — logs show "cublasLt: fallback to algo id=23 (scalar)" for the MxK shapes produced by our blocked matmul pattern. snippet:
```
[cublas] selected algo 3
[cublas] fallback to algo 23 for m=2048 k=4096 n=1024
```
kevin: can you paste the nsys command + env you used? we should reproduce locally and try forcing algos.
maria: run:
```
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 nsys profile --output bench.ns ./benchmarks/run_infer.sh --model l2-13b --seq 2048 --quant int8
export REDWOOD_CUBLAS_ALGO_PIN=7  # test
```
perfbot: benchmark run finished: artifacts uploaded s3://redwood-bench/1715559876.tar.gz and dashboard https://perf.redwood/bench/1715559876
oliver: have you tried forcing a specific cuBLAS algo or using cutlass/cublasLt config? pinning could be a stopgap.
maria: yes — forcing algo id 7 on GCP dropped p95 to 46ms (close to AWS/Azure). so selection heuristics are the issue, not thermal or hw variance. we'll add a pinned fallback in the inference shim when cross-cloud parity fails.
sam: action: add a parity check to the model bring-up checklist. if p95_delta>20% between two clouds for same SKU, auto-run algo pin sweep and pin best stable algo.
jun: sgtm :thumbsup:
kevin: also note to add a short test that compares cuBLAS dispatch logs during onboarding so we can detect heuristics flips early.
maria: I'll open a follow-up PR with the test + pinned-fallback logic and attach the nsys traces. filing ticket and looping infra to check node images too.
oliver: thanks — ping me on the PR and i'll help reproduce on our GCP fleet.
